_meanings:
.²1 A perpetual or running commentary which explains and analyses every
 word; {#wIkA nirantaravyAKyA paYjikA padanaktikA#}.
.²2 A journal, a book in which accounts of receipts and expenditure are entered.
.²3 The record or register of human actions kept by Yama. (For other senses
 see {#paYji#} above).

.²1 a scribe.
.²2 a man of the Kāyastha tribe.
.²3 an almanac-maker.
